description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' along with related subcomponents for displaying user details and user projects within a modal dialog. It includes UI rendering logic, hooks usage, and external component references.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A React functional component that displays user details in a styled grid, including name, email, department, and tenant.
